question: The Ecomark logo of India is/are:
solution:
The correct answer is __Earthen pot.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Eco mark scheme

 
 
• The nationwide scheme was launched by the Ministry of Environment and Forests, Government of India in 1991 through Gazette Notification no. 71, for easy identification of environment-friendly products present in the market.
 
• The Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) issues the certification mark to eco-friendly products.
 
• Logo - The Earthen Pot is chosen as the logo for the scheme due to the following reasons
 
 
• Made up of renewable source 
 
• Does not produce hazardous waste
 
• Consumes little energy in making
 
• Every section of society can relate to it, thus the message can be spread more efficiently
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Objectives 

 
 
• To provide an incentive for manufacturers and importers to reduce the usage of products that have an adverse effect on the environment.
 
• To reward genuine initiatives taken by companies in order to reduce the adverse environmental impact of their products.
 
• To assist consumers to become environmentally responsible in their daily lives by providing information to take account of environmental factors in their purchase decisions.
 
• To encourage citizens to purchase products that have less harmful environmental impacts.
 
• To improve the quality of the environment and to encourage the sustainable management of resources.
 
 
 
• Criteria - The product should have the following features to qualify for the eco mark:
 
 
• ​The product must be substantially less pollution-causing than other comparable products in production, usage and disposal.
 
• Should be recyclable and made from recycled products or bio-degradable materials.
 
• The product should make a significant contribution to saving non-renewable resources.
 
• The product must contribute to a reduction of the adverse primary criteria which has the highest environmental impact associated with the use of the product, and which will be specifically set for each of the product categories.
